🪄 BLUEPRINT MODE Help me build a lesson Answer a few questions, then build a differentiated lesson step by step with AlloBot.
💡 Lumen Research sources or explore data in one evidence workspace. Cite exact passages and keep uncertainty and provenance visible.
📄 Document Hub Document builder with themes, WYSIWYG editing, accessibility audit, and multi-format export (PDF, HTML, worksheet, slides)
✏️ Whiteboard Sketch ideas, build diagrams, and map thinking with graphic organizers and one-click image export.
🧵 Learning Web: Unit Path Arrange lessons into a teachable sequence, then inspect linked standards and evidence in the shared Learning Web.
🎨 Page Designer Create flyers, worksheets, posters, and slide decks with accessible exports, reading order, alt text, and a hand/AI process record.
🎥 Video Studio Record, trim, caption, and export short videos, with prompt tools for NotebookLM and other AI video tools.
🪧 Symbol Studio AI-generated PCS-style icons for visual supports, AAC boards, and schedules — powered by image-to-image editing
📊 AlloSheet (Pilot) Explore educator data with agent assistance, review every change before applying it, and run local audits.
🗓️ Polls & Sign-ups Schedule a meeting, collect sign-ups, or run a quick word cloud or rating. Share by link or QR code — no account required.
🗒️ Assessment Center Screening batteries, CBM probes, RTI decision aids, intervention logs, and student progress.
🩺 Dynamic Assessment Create dynamic, standard-aligned assessment tasks for diagnostic checks
👁️ BehaviorLens FBA/BIP behavioral observation, ABC data collection, and 80+ clinical tools
📝 Report Writer AI-powered clinical report generation with fact-chunks, accuracy audit, and developmental norms
♿ Document accessibility Improve PDFs, Word documents, slides, spreadsheets, images, and web content. Review accessibility checks and export accessible formats.

🔍 Accessibility Lab Verify the student experience: preview as student, keyboard-only tour, live WCAG audit (axe-core) with violations framed by student impact, screen-reader announcement preview, and disability simulators (low-vision, color-blindness, dyslexia, motor delay).
🗂️ Community Catalog Browse open-licensed lessons from the AlloFlow community, or submit your own for review
📇 Research Suite Run a named study: IRB tracking, consent provenance, Likert instruments, fidelity logs, and the study bundle export.
🎓 Professional Development Work through short, self-paced modules, take a knowledge check, and download a completion record.

🏛️ Leadership Hub For leaders: conduct UDL walkthroughs, examine disproportionality patterns, and document meetings with aggregate or de-identified, device-only data. Reports are descriptive, not evaluative.

🎟️ School Rewards & Store Award recognition points and open the school-owned rewards ledger and prize store. The ledger lives in your school Google Workspace; the staff share link and setup checklist are inside.

✉️ Communications Studio Family updates, batch report-card comments, recommendation letters and replies to families, drafted only from your notes. Codenames only, plain-language check, optional translation draft, send to your Drive. Nothing is emailed from here.
